audit_items.proof_trace: The weight accumulation logic for batch verification is implemented in the external C-KZG-4844 library (github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/v2), not in the Prysm codebase. The Prysm code is a thin wrapper that performs type conversions and delegates to ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch. Auditing the correctness of the external library's cryptographic implementation is outside the scope of the Prysm codebase audit.
